widgets:
This (HC) SSF Tactician Mercenary  leveling build guide will allow you to complete the campaign safely and quickly, while melting bosses and transition easily into the endgame. 
What this guide will teach you:
When and how to craft the best weapons that will carry you through the game.
All the information about skills, how to use them, and what the best Passive Tree choices are to enhance your build.
Important gear suggestions to help you stay alive. 
How to easily progress your character through the early endgame into T15 maps and Pinnacle Bosses.
BUILD OVERVIEW
This build utilizes Pin from the Tactician Mercenary ascendancy to hold enemies in place, and stop them from attacking. This is achieved through the “Right Where We Want Them” ascendancy node. This notable is incredibly powerful, and also enables you to inflict Pin buildup with any projectile attack.
While your enemies are stuck in place, blow them to pieces with an arsenal of different grenades. This build has insane AoE clearing damage as well as extremely solid single target damage.
Defensive wise, the Tactician's Pin is the best form of croud-control in the game. On top of that we will be taking advantage of Armour and its application to Elemental Damage, Evasion, Deflect and Runic Ward to stay alive.
SKILLS & ROTATION
Use a combination of , ,  ,  and   to build Pin on enemies and blow them to smitherines. 
Use  to detonate your  immediately when you don't want to wait for them to blow up.
While clearing, your general skill rotation is to rotate between , ,  and  to deal damage - while using  for areas with high monster density. This synergizes perfectly with the  notable on the Passive Tree, adding alot of extra fire damage.
Early on, we utilize  to apply Elemental Exposure, before replacing this with  in Act 3.
For mobility, we use  with a Talisman on Weapon Swap 2 to dractiscally increase movement speed, while also allowing us to jump across difficult terrain.
DEFENSIVE & SPIRIT SKILLS
For Spirit Skills, we use a combination of  for increased Single Target / Boss DPS and  to improve your Armour Rating. This build constantly breaks armour due to the  Passive Tree Notable, which allows you to break 50% armour when you pin an enemy. Which you will be doing ALOT OF. This also synergizes really well with , which increases the Armour Break debuff to 35%, and has this debuff apply to increased Fire damage taken as well. 
Once we are in the endgame and have a decent  with Spirit on it, we then swap to a Rage setup, taking advantage of ,  to increase our Attack Damage, while also increasing our Fire Damage with .
ACT 4 SHARK FIN REWARD
30% increased Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield
WEAPON SETS
This build takes advtanage of two different Weapon Sets to use two different Crossbows in the endgame. Not sure how that system works? No worries, I've got you covered. I've broken it down in a video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BtzgJVSFLB4

Changes since the Endgame Update 1 Build Variant / Video:
New Weapon: Upgraded to a new  with higher DPS, along with a high roll of Flat Lightning Damage. This added lightning damage allows us to Shock our enemies without the use of . If you're interested seeing how I incorporated Shock into the build for higher single target DPS on Bosses, please view the previous "Endgame Update 1" build variant.
New Spirit Gem: We are now nolonger using , and have aquired a amulet with high Spirit, which allows us to use the Spirit Gem . This compliments , giving us a nice damage boost over what  gave us. The  effect also increases our Fire Damage that we gain through the  node on the Passive Tree. 
Solving Life Regeneration: To counteract the Life Regeneration issue caused by , we have switched to an  body armour base which has an implicit of Life Regeneration. This combined with  allows us to regenerate life faster than we lose it.
Smoother Mapping: We have allocated all Weapon Set 2 (green line) passive points to help reduce the cooldown of  grenade as much as possible for a smoother mapping experience. We have allocated all Weapon Set 1 (red line) passive points to further strengthen our  for single target damage.
Solving Mana Sustain: Through the use of 3 different jewels, prioritzing "%Skill Mana Costs Converted To Life Costs" on Ruby Jewels, and "Recover % Max Mana On Kill" on Saphire Jewels, combined with Mana Leech on our Crossbow and Mana On Kill on our gloves, we are able to sustain mana comfortably while mapping and in boss fights.
Stronger Defences: We are now using  to convert all Evasion to Armour, and are Armour Stacking. This results in a high Deflection rating through the  Ascendancy node. Combined with as much life as possible on gear, and "%Armour Applies to Elemental Damage", we are feeling tanky enough to push through juiced content.

Players have #% less Cooldown Recovery Rate
Players have #% less Recovery Rate of Life and Energy Shield
Try to avoid running maps with these mods whenever possible. Use this Regex in your Stash Search Bar to automatically filter out maps with these mod (make sure to copy the quotations): "!less r|s coo"

Extremely strong Single Target and Burst damage.
Solid AoE clearing.
Completely SSF / HC viable, with no reliance on any unique items.
Easily moves from the campaign to endgame.
Pin is an insanely strong defensive layer, allowing you to hold enemies in place, and making them unable to attack you.
Pin doesn't have an internal cooldown like other CC mechanics (freeze, stun, electrocute). This allows you to chain Pin monsters and bosses.

A bit clunky of a playstyle, especially in Act 1.
Low visual clarity at the very high end, with many explosions. 
Heavily reliant on a good Crossbow.

To take advantage of Weapon Set's, you need to allocate which Weapon your Skill Gem will be using. Here's a step-by-step breakdown of how to do this:
Open up your Skill Gem Interface by Pressing "G"
Click on the Small ➡️ Icon beside where the DMG of your skill is displayed (Top Right of Each Skill Box)
At the bottrom left corner of the Skill Information box that will open up after clicking the ➡️, you will see text that says "Use With Weapon Set:" with a 1 and 2 and two check boxes.
Skills by default will be assigned to both Weapon Sets.
For all of the skills listed above, make sure they ONLY have one checkmark according to which Weapon Set I've listed.
All grenade skills should be set to Weapon Set 1, and ONLY Explosive Shot should be on Weapon Set 2.
An important thing to also double check is to make sure your  is equipped in your first Weapon Set as well!
As always, if you have any questions I'm happy to answer them on Twitch, Youtube or Discord.

variants.desc:
This is my current endgame setup based on my progression thus far after 50+ hours on the character.
Video Guide: https://youtu.be/Q9Wr0nT2C7s?si=y3gWVljBUS3bmBVF
Changes since the Endgame Update 1 Build Variant / Video:
New Weapon: Upgraded to a new  with higher DPS, along with a high roll of Flat Lightning Damage. This added lightning damage allows us to Shock our enemies without the use of . If you're interested seeing how I incorporated Shock into the build for higher single target DPS on Bosses, please view the previous "Endgame Update 1" build variant.
New Spirit Gem: We are now nolonger using , and have aquired a amulet with high Spirit, which allows us to use the Spirit Gem . This compliments , giving us a nice damage boost over what  gave us. The  effect also increases our Fire Damage that we gain through the  node on the Passive Tree. 
Solving Life Regeneration: To counteract the Life Regeneration issue caused by , we have switched to an  body armour base which has an implicit of Life Regeneration. This combined with  allows us to regenerate life faster than we lose it.
Smoother Mapping: We have allocated all Weapon Set 2 (green line) passive points to help reduce the cooldown of  grenade as much as possible for a smoother mapping experience. We have allocated all Weapon Set 1 (red line) passive points to further strengthen our  for single target damage.
Solving Mana Sustain: Through the use of 3 different jewels, prioritzing "%Skill Mana Costs Converted To Life Costs" on Ruby Jewels, and "Recover % Max Mana On Kill" on Saphire Jewels, combined with Mana Leech on our Crossbow and Mana On Kill on our gloves, we are able to sustain mana comfortably while mapping and in boss fights.
Stronger Defences: We are now using  to convert all Evasion to Armour, and are Armour Stacking. This results in a high Deflection rating through the  Ascendancy node. Combined with as much life as possible on gear, and "%Armour Applies to Elemental Damage", we are feeling tanky enough to push through juiced content.
Dangerous Map Modifiers:
Our character is negatively impacted by:
Players have #% less Cooldown Recovery Rate
Players have #% less Recovery Rate of Life and Energy Shield
Try to avoid running maps with these mods whenever possible. Use this Regex in your Stash Search Bar to automatically filter out maps with these mod (make sure to copy the quotations): "!less r|s coo"
